title: Norvik Analytics raises $45M Series B led by Halcyon Ventures
content: Oslo-based Norvik Analytics, which sells demand forecasting software to retailers, has raised a $45 million Series B led by Halcyon Ventures, with participation from existing investor Fjord Capital. The round brings Norvik Analytics' total funding to $61 million. CEO Ingrid Solberg said the money will fund expansion into Germany and the UK.

title: Pricing | Norvik Analytics
content: Demand forecasting plans for retailers: Starter, Growth and Enterprise. Save with annual billing.
raw_content:
# Pricing

Demand forecasting for retailers of every size. Prices in USD.

## Starter

**$290/month** billed annually ($350 billed monthly)

- Up to 5 stores
- Weekly forecasts
- Email support

## Growth

**$890/month** billed annually ($1,090 billed monthly)

- Up to 50 stores
- Daily store- and SKU-level forecasts
- Promotions and weather signals
- Shared Slack support channel

## Enterprise

Custom pricing for unlimited stores, on-premise connectors and a dedicated forecasting analyst. [Talk to sales](https://www.norvikanalytics.com/contact)

---

Prices updated October 1, 2026.

*March 4, 2025*

Existing customers keep their price until renewal.
